items.title: redactMemoryPackForControlArm empties every serialized memory-pack surface on the control arm
items.context: main's B-ab8d gates only the 7 TEXT renders (surfaceRuntimeMemoryPack) and keeps the pack in JSON 'for lossless measurement', leaving the JSON/--output surfaces host-readable. redactMemoryPackForControlArm (core/runtime-memory-arm-gate.ts, keyed on resolveExperimentArm) empties results/items, nulls sourceDigests, collapses packDigest, and fails CLOSED on control; applied at done_closure/final_response_check/host_dispatch/handoff_create/handoff_resume JSON + the prefetch manifest. Measurement stays lossless via the experience_pack_surfaced event.
items.userSees: With LATTICE_EXPERIMENT_ARM=control and LATTICE_EXPERIMENT_ID set, done_closure --json, host_dispatch --json, handoff_create --json and handoff_resume --json return a memoryFreshnessPack with empty results/items arrays, nulled sourceDigests, and the content-free empty-set packDigest (4f53cda1...), and the prefetch manifest carries no memoryPackDigest/memoryTopHitIds; on treatment and no-experiment the pack is fully populated and unchanged.

happy.desc: control done_closure/handoff/host_dispatch --json return empty result/item arrays + empty-set packDigest

edge.desc: treatment and no-experiment JSON packs are byte-identical to pre-isolation (redaction is a no-op)

adversarial.desc: redaction fails CLOSED on control (a throwing pack yields empty surfaces, never the populated one) and no stored id survives serialization; sourceDigests fingerprints nulled

verificationEvidence.note: e2e asserts control done_closure/final_response_check --json return empty result/item arrays + empty-set packDigest; treatment/normal populated.
gate smoke CHK-B asserts treatment + no-experiment packs returned byte-identical (redaction is a no-op outside control).
gate smoke CHK-B asserts fail-CLOSED (throwing pack -> empty surfaces + empty-set digest) and sourceDigests fingerprints nulled + no stored id in serialization.

items.title: final_response_check routes through the shared arm render gate and redacts its JSON pack
items.context: main's surfaceRuntimeMemoryPack was wired at 7 consumers; final_response_check (handlers/playbook-runtime-memory.ts) rendered + returned the pack UNGATED. It now calls surfaceRuntimeMemoryPack (fires experience_pack_surfaced on both arms, suppresses the text section on control) and returns redactMemoryPackForControlArm(pack) as memoryFreshnessPack.
items.userSees: On control, final_response_check text omits the memory summary (no memoryTopHitIds line) and its --json memoryFreshnessPack is empty; on treatment/normal the summary renders and the JSON pack is populated; the consumer-wiring health oracle requires surfaceRuntimeMemoryPack at the final_response_check site.

happy.desc: control final_response_check --json pack empty + text omits memoryTopHitIds; treatment/normal populated

edge.desc: playbook_runtime_health required-class checks redact topHitIds/packDigest on control

adversarial.desc: the wiring oracle fails if final_response_check stops routing through surfaceRuntimeMemoryPack (drift guard)

verificationEvidence.note: e2e asserts control final_response_check --json pack empty + text omits memoryTopHitIds; treatment/normal populated.
health required-class redaction uses redactMemoryPackForControlArm, whose topHitIds/packDigest emptying is asserted by gate smoke CHK-B (the primitive the health path applies).

playbook_runtime_health consumer-wiring:src/handlers/playbook-runtime-memory.ts = pass, i.e. the drift oracle requires surfaceRuntimeMemoryPack at final_response_check; it fails if that routing is removed.

items.title: parallel dispatch injects no experience on control; two corpus tools added to the memoryRetrieval block
items.context: experienceRefs() (core/lattice-parallel-wave.ts) is the single chokepoint for parallel_dispatch/report/plan experience injection; it returns [] on control. memory_benchmark_real_data (exports the real corpus) and source_lineage_audit (surfaces dev-memory ids+paths) are added to command-policy.ts memoryRetrieval markers so main's block refuses them on control.
items.userSees: On control, parallel_dispatch --includeExperience returns experienceRefs=[]; memory_benchmark_real_data and source_lineage_audit are refused with 'memory retrieval is disabled on the control arm'; treatment and no-experiment are unaffected.

edge.desc: memory_benchmark_real_data + source_lineage_audit refused on control, permitted on no-experiment

adversarial.desc: the experienceRefs chokepoint gates ALL injection paths (dispatch/report/plan), not just one

verificationEvidence.note: control parallel_dispatch --includeExperience returns experienceRefs=[] (verified: count 0); treatment populates them.
e2e asserts memory_benchmark_real_data + source_lineage_audit refused on control ('memory retrieval is disabled on the control arm'), permitted on no-experiment.

experienceRefs() is the SINGLE chokepoint gating dispatch/report/plan injection (returns [] on control before includeExperience); the e2e exercises it via parallel_dispatch and the code has exactly one injection site.
